title: Audit PDF + CSV for search ID 9920424e… — refile of the boxed single-row request W013308
summary:
A two-item refile of W013308-082426, seeking the same single search-audit record in different record products. The search is ID 9920424e-bfd0-4f87-8423-6abce941fdc7, search time 03/05/2026 10:15:07 PM UTC.

- Item 1: the platform's Audit PDF report covering 2026-03-05, as generated by the platform, including this search's row with every field that report includes.
- Item 2: the record for the same search in the platform's CSV export, with every field the export includes.

For both items, any withheld portion must be marked in place with a marker distinguishing a withheld value from a field the platform left empty.

The request states in its own terms what the platform holds: each search records both a user-selected offense category and a user-typed reason, the Audit PDF renders typed text that the spreadsheet export's Reason column can omit, and the Department publishes the offense category of each of its searches on its public transparency portal. For this row the category is "Homicide/Death Investigation" and the typed reason is "Ivne".

It distinguishes itself from W013308 on the record: that request was answered 2026-09-02 with a spreadsheet export rendered to PDF, in which "Homicide/Death" was redacted from the category while "Investigation" was left in place, the typed reason did not appear at all, no withheld field was marked as such, and no field-specific statement was given. It asks to be processed as a new request.

If anything is withheld, the § 7922.540 determination must identify each field withheld, the exemption for that field, and the § 7922.525(b) basis for no reasonably segregable portion. Two values are named for specific justification: the offense category (or the words "Homicide/Death" within it), which the Department publishes on its portal for every search, and the typed reason "Ivne".

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection ... after deletion of the portions that are exempt by law
policy_promises.tests: Whether segregability survives being asked field-by-field on one row, where the category half left visible under W013308 shows the Department already segregating inside the field.

policy_promises.quote: agency must state the exemption in writing if it withholds
policy_promises.tests: Whether a request naming two specific values produces a field-specific written determination, after W013308 was answered with no marking and no field-specific statement.

policy_promises.quote: records of investigations conducted by, or investigatory files compiled by, any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Whether an offense category the Department itself publishes on its transparency portal can be exempt as to this record, and whether the four-letter typed reason "Ivne" carries investigative content.

prior_pra_refs.note: Parent request for the same row, answered 2026-09-02 in spreadsheet-export format with "Homicide/Death" boxed and "Investigation" left standing, the reason field absent, and no field-specific determination. This request seeks the Audit PDF and CSV products instead, and asks that it be processed as new.
The rolling audit production whose March 2026 export contains this row. Not cited in the request text, so the answer cannot be folded back into the W012541 production.
Denied in full 2026-08-04 on a § 7923.600 theory applied to audit-export fields generally; this request continues to test that theory on one identified row.

filed_because: W013308 asked for one identified audit row and got a spreadsheet export rendered to PDF: the category was cut in half, with "Homicide/Death" boxed and "Investigation" left visible, the typed reason "Ivne" did not appear anywhere, nothing was marked as withheld, and no field-specific determination accompanied it. That answer chose the one record product whose Reason column can be empty without any redaction being made, so absence and withholding are indistinguishable. This refile names the two products that cannot do that — the platform's Audit PDF report, which renders the typed text, and the CSV export — and requires withheld portions to be marked in place so an empty field is distinguishable from a removed one. It also recites, as facts the Department is aware of, that the platform stores both fields and that the Department publishes the offense category of every search on its own transparency portal, which leaves no reading on which "Homicide/Death" is exempt as to this row while the same value is public for every other search.
